auth.title: Yingira okweyongerayo
auth.subtitle: Kozesa akawunti yo eya Google okuyingira mu Gabla. Tewetaaga password.
auth.reconnectToggle: Wali wayingira edda ng'omuweereza naye tolaba profile yo?
auth.reconnectSent: Singa email eyo ya akawunti y'omuweereza, tukutumidde link okuddamu okwegatta ku Google. Kebera inbox yo.
auth.reconnectHelp: Wandiika email bizinensi yo gye yawandiisiddwa, tukutumire link okuddamu okwegatta ku Google.
auth.googleNoToken: Google teyaddizza token y'okuyingira. Gezaako nate.

welcome.title: Tukutegeke
welcome.subtitle: Kitwala amasekondi matono, era kituyamba okukulaga ebiri okumpi naawe.
welcome.errImageType: Londa ekifaananyi kya JPG, PNG, WebP oba GIF.
welcome.errPhotoSize: Ekifaananyi ekyo kisukka 5 MB - londa ekitono.

welcome.areaHelp: Bw'otokigabana kifo kyo, tujja kukulaga ebintu ebisinga okuba okumpi n'eno disitulikiti ebisooka.

cart.title: Ensawo yo y'okugula
cart.someFailed: Ebiragiro ebimu tebyatumibwa - {{details}}. Ebiragiro byo ebirala bitumiddwa; ebisigaddewo gezaako nate.
cart.sentOnlineBody: Buli musuubuzi ajja kukakasa nti ekiragiro kyo kiriwo. Tewali ssente zisaliddwa. Omusuubuzi bw'akkiriza, tujja kukuweereza email era osobola okumusasula ne mobile money okuva mu Ebiragiro byange.
cart.sentCashBodyDelivery: Buli musuubuzi alina ekiragiro kyo era ajja kukukubira ku {{phone}} okukakasa. Tewali ssente zisaliddwa — sasula mu buliwo bwe bakuleetera.
cart.sentCashBodyPickup: Buli musuubuzi alina ekiragiro kyo era ajja kukukubira ku {{phone}} okukakasa. Tewali ssente zisaliddwa — sasula mu buliwo bw'ojja okukitwala.
cart.onlineNote_one: Ekiragiro kyo kigenda eri omusuubuzi okukakasa nti kiriwo. Tewali kisaliddwa kati; omusuubuzi bw'akkiriza osasula {{amount}} ne mobile money okuva mu Ebiragiro byange.
cart.onlineNote_other: Ebiragiro byo {{count}} bigenda eri abasuubuzi okukakasa nti biriwo. Tewali kisaliddwa kati; omusuubuzi bw'akkiriza omusasula ne mobile money okuva mu Ebiragiro byange (omugatte {{amount}}).
cart.cashNotePickup_one: Ekiragiro kyo kigenda butereevu eri omusuubuzi. Osasula {{amount}} mu buliwo ng'ojja okutwala ekiragiro kyo.
cart.cashNotePickup_other: Ebiragiro byo {{count}} bigenda butereevu eri abasuubuzi. Osasula {{amount}} mu buliwo ng'ojja okutwala ebiragiro byo.
cart.cashNoteDelivery_one: Ekiragiro kyo kigenda butereevu eri omusuubuzi. Osasula {{amount}} mu buliwo ng'ofunye ekiragiro kyo.
cart.cashNoteDelivery_other: Ebiragiro byo {{count}} bigenda butereevu eri abasuubuzi. Osasula {{amount}} mu buliwo ng'ofunye ebiragiro byo.

orders.acceptedPayHint: Omusuubuzi akkirizza ekiragiro kyo. Sasula kati okukakasa. Tewali kisaliddwa okutuusa lw'osasula.

orders.receiptSoon: Receipt yo egenda kulabika wano mangu.
orders.quotationSoon: Quotation y'omusuubuzi etuuka mu email era ewano mu ddakiika emu ng'omaze okuwa ekiragiro. Receipt yo ejja bw'omala okusasula.
orders.bookingsSubtitle: Bbookinga zo eza wooteeri, ebifo n'okusisinkana, n'ekyo omuweereza ky'addizza.
orders.subtitle: Buli kye wasaba, wamu ne quotations z'abasuubuzi ne receipts zo.
